Progressive Encephalomyelitis with Rigidity and Myoclonus (PERM) is a rare disorder on the Stiff Person Syndrome (SPS) spectrum and is associated with anti-glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD) and anti-glycine antibodies. In addition to the characteristic SPS symptoms of limb stiffness and progressive gait difficulty, PERM includes brainstem signs, autonomic dysfunction, and encephalopathy.
